module.purpose: Exposes React form-action hooks (useFormStatus, useFormState, requestFormReset) that delegate to the active renderer's dispatcher. Also exports NotPending, a frozen singleton representing the non-pending form status. Defines Flow types for form status as a discriminated union keyed on the pending boolean field. Acts as the public interface between React's reconciler hooks and the ReactDOM renderer for form-related state management.
module.summary: This module is a bridge between React's reconciler dispatcher and the ReactDOM renderer for form actions. It defines three Flow types — FormStatusNotPending, FormStatusPending, and FormStatus (a discriminated union on the pending field) — and exports them for consumer type-checking. A shared immutable singleton (sharedNotPendingObject) is frozen via Object.freeze in development mode and exported as NotPending. The internal resolveDispatcher helper mirrors React's own hook dispatcher resolution from react/src/ReactHooks.js, reading ReactSharedInternals.H and validating in __DEV__ mode that a dispatcher exists (indicating the call is within a function component render). useFormStatus delegates to dispatcher.useHostTransitionStatus to read the current pending state. useFormState wraps a form action callback with state, generics over state and payload types, and an optional permalink parameter, delegating to dispatcher.useFormState. requestFormReset triggers a form reset by calling through ReactDOMSharedInternals.d.r, which is the ReactDOM current dispatcher's reset handler. All three public hooks follow the Rules of Hooks and must be called during the render phase to access the correct dispatcher. The file uses Flow type annotations throughout and is processed by the React build system with the __DEV__ compile-time flag.
module.businessContext: Provides React form action hooks used by components to manage form submission state and reset behavior within the DOM renderer environment. If these hooks fail, form submissions will not trigger server actions and form resets will not propagate to the UI.

concurrencyModel.notes: All functions are synchronous. Hooks must be called during the render phase to access the correct dispatcher (rules of hooks). The dispatcher is thread-local to the current render fiber. Reentrant calls are unsafe as the dispatcher changes per render.

units.name: useFormStatus

detail.name: useFormStatus
preconditions: The calling environment must be within a React render or hook context where a dispatcher is available.
resolveDispatcher() must return a dispatcher implementing useHostTransitionStatus().
postconditions: On invocation, returns a FormStatus object reflecting the host transition state for form actions.
The returned object is stable across renders when the underlying dispatcher state does not change.
invariants: The function delegates entirely to the resolved dispatcher's useHostTransitionStatus() on every call.
The return shape conforms to the FormStatus interface declared in the shared types.
edgeCases: If resolveDispatcher() returns a dispatcher without useHostTransitionStatus(), a TypeError is raised.
When invoked outside a React render context, resolveDispatcher() may throw or return an incompatible dispatcher.
The returned FormStatus object reflects the latest pending/active state on each subsequent render.

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: Re-throws any error produced by resolveDispatcher() or the dispatcher's useHostTransitionStatus().

detail.summary: Resolves the current React dispatcher and returns the host transition status object, exposing whether a form-related host transition is pending or active to consuming form components.
